title: Diagnostic and Therapeutic Applications of Microarrays in Lung Transplantation
official: Multi-Centric Observational Study to Analyze the Diagnostic Molecular Features in the Clinical Setting of Lung Allograft Biopsies
summary: Objective: To evaluate the potential impact of molecular phenotyping of transbronchial biopsies in lung transplant recipients with allograft dysfunction, and the potential for developing a safer endobronchial mucosal biopsy format.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All lung transplant recipients undergoing a biopsy as determined by their surgeon or physician.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who declined participation or unable to give informed consent.
